info.text:
Free ChatGPT is about to get picture ads.
Oct 5, 2026: OpenAI said visual ads will appear next to ChatGPT image results, starting with a US test later in October.
Ads show only on Free and Go ($8/month). Plus ($20/month, $240 a year) and higher plans have none. Free users can opt out of ads in exchange for lower message limits.
ChatGPT reaches 1.2 billion weekly users (Sep 2026), and its ads hit a $1 billion annualized run rate by Aug 31, 2026.
Sources: OpenAI, TechCrunch, Axios, Digiday.
News and education, not financial advice.
